instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Lumina Holdings operates as a family-owned mixed-crop farm managing 120 hectares of irrigated land across cereals, vegetables, and olives. We are currently focusing on adopting precision agriculture technologies to optimize water usage through sensor data and reduce chemical inputs for improved sustainability. The company is growing rapidly but struggles with the formal integration of these new technological capabilities into existing operational workflows.
answers.pastInitiatives: Our digital transformation program is in its third year with a dedicated transformation office reporting to the CEO. We have completed an ERP migration to the cloud, rolled out a company-wide data warehouse with self-service BI dashboards, and established a center of excellence for process automation using RPA and low-code tools. The program has delivered €2.4M in annualized cost savings to date.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has mandated that 25% of revenue should come from products or services that did not exist 3 years ago. This requires us to systematically explore adjacent markets, new customer segments, and alternative monetization models beyond traditional commodity sales. We are open to both organic build initiatives and strategic acquisitions of small, innovative companies that can serve as diversification platforms.
answers.additionalContext: The company currently operates in a fragmented market where operational efficiency drives short-term gains, making risk mitigation paramount for new ventures. The immediate challenge is translating high-level diversification mandates into tangible, capital-efficient projects.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

opportunities.title: Precision Data Service for Neighboring Farms (SaaS)
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the existing data warehouse and precision agriculture tech, Lumina could offer a low-risk subscription service providing anonymized crop health insights to smaller neighboring operations. This aligns with diversification goals by creating a new revenue stream.

first_actions: Pilot the data sharing module with three identified neighbors.
Develop a basic tiered pricing model for the service.
resources_needed: Internal data science time allocation (5 hours/week)
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 5 paying pilot customers within 9 months.
milestones: M1: Beta launch of service features complete (Month 3)
M2: Secure first paying customer contract (Month 6)

opportunities.title: Value-Added Crop Processing and Branding
opportunities.rationale: Expanding the existing product portfolio by investing in mild processing capabilities (e.g., specialized olive oil or dried vegetable blends) creates a new revenue stream without requiring significant capital investment outside of controlled facility upgrades.

first_actions: Conduct feasibility study on local food processing standards.
Identify a partner for initial co-packing/labeling services.
resources_needed: Consultant fees for regulatory compliance review
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 5% revenue contribution from value-added products within the fiscal year.
milestones: M2: First commercial sale of processed product (Month 12)

opportunities.title: Acquisition of Niche Bio-Input Startup
opportunities.rationale: To achieve diversification quickly, acquiring a small, high-tech startup specializing in proprietary biological pest control agents could provide an immediate and distinct entry into the agricultural technology space. This accelerates market presence significantly.

first_actions: Define clear acquisition criteria focusing on IP strength and synergy with existing precision tech.
resources_needed: Internal leadership time commitment (full-time for 6 months)
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful acquisition of a target company with >2 patents within 18 months.
milestones: M1: Target identification and initial contact (Month 3)
M2: Finalized purchase agreement and funding secured (Month 9)

next_steps.action: Establish a formal, ring-fenced 'Sandbox' budget for high-risk diversification experiments.
Launch an external talent search focused on ag-tech specialists to address the identified talent barrier.

key_weaknesses: Lack of dedicated, ring-fenced innovation budget (4% is insufficient for growth initiatives).
Ad-hoc integration between digital tools leading to inefficient data utilization.
Significant reliance on informal customer feedback channels that limit scalable product development.
